description: Pinned T-SQL probes that SqlToolsService's Table Designer feature emits. The designer opens an initialized snapshot of the table's definition, lets the user edit columns/constraints, previews a target definition, then publishes via ALTER TABLE (or DROP+CREATE for incompatible changes). Iridium supports simple tables (int/varchar/datetime columns, primary keys, NULL defaults); columnstore/temporal/graph/memory-optimized are emitted as UnsupportedFeatureError.
status_note: JSON-RPC framing not exercised; only T-SQL contract asserted. Unsupported table families surfaced via the editability probe returning an error payload.

requests.tds_probe: SELECT t.name, SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) AS schema_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable')

SELECT c.name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable') ORDER BY c.column_id

SELECT i.name, COL_NAME(ic.object_id, ic.column_id) AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable') AND i.is_primary_key = 1
ALTER TABLE dbo.MyTable ADD newcol INT NULL
ALTER TABLE dbo.MyTable DROP COLUMN oldcol
SELECT t.is_memory_optimized, t.temporal_type, t.is_edge, t.is_node FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable')
